summary_12_lines: 1. Exposure: each Battleship implement packet (33-46 KB) prints its own step in full, earlier steps' whole summaries (0/495/782/1,082 B for S1-S4), later steps by first sentence (114/99/84/0 B), the step-plan result path 3 times, and a 1,220 B work-item context naming every step's checks and order; Improve handoffs (29-32 KB) repeat this with a 3,328 B full context.

2. Behaviour: 0 of 16 Battleship step actions (8 implement, 8 Improve) wrote a later step's paths; cross-step reads were dependencies (S2 read S1, S3 read S2), one grep of the whole step plan (S3), S4 copying S3's result/notes as a format template, and S2-revisit opening S1's packet. Wandering is a byte and pointer cost here, not an observed behaviour.

3. Duplication: each S2-S4 packet prints the previous step's summary twice (Accepted step line and LAST ACCEPTED SUMMARY, 269-477 B), and the revisit summaries ('Carried over unchanged') replaced S1's real learning (Apex Long overflow limbs) in every later packet.

4. Recommend: current step in full; earlier steps one line each (id, short commit, headline); later steps by count only; one step-plan locator (the Files line); drop the duplicate LAST ACCEPTED block and the receipt pointer at an implement step. Generated in step_block, _step_lines, handoff_lines, _builds_on_lines, _last_accepted_lines, improve_handoff_text.

5. Commits: the Battleship worktree has 21 commits: 13 by ShipLoop scripts (1 empty baseline, 9 knowledge, 1 item commit at verify, 2 leftovers), 8 by Improve through improve-pass (model-written messages), 0 typed by a model.

6. 9 of 21 carry a lessons section (8 Improve 'Key learnings', 1 release-verify 'Learned'); 1 carries decisions (release-verify 'Key considerations'); 5 cite earlier commits (Learned-from); 11 are subject-only bookkeeping.

7. Implement steps are not committed per step today (0 of 8): S1, S2, S4 code and S3's html/meta land in the verify item commit a62baf4 (message = verify summary, no labels); S3's whole new slBattleBoard.js (128 lines) landed in Improve commit 4c5b99b under the review's subject. Chess: 0 step commits, 0 implement Improve commits.

8. Look-back today: only intake and discovery quote commits (knowledge_home.stage_lines -> recent_commits; Battleship quoted the empty baseline); the Improve route makes the model run git log -7 (23 runs over 13 Battleship actions); 0 of 8 implement producers ran git log; 0 packets carried 'Last accepted Improve lessons'; 0 of 16 receipt pointers were opened.

9. Result: the S3 Improve's race learning (commit 4c5b99b: New game must ignore an in-flight fire) reached no later packet by value; git commits were the only by-value store of Improve lessons in this run.

10. Design: at an inline implement step's accepted 'complete' (gates passed, after save, before any Improve edit), ShipLoop commits the step's changed declared paths (HOME excluded) as 'feat(<item>/<step>): <headline>' with Key learnings, Key decisions, Evidence (script-built) and Related commits (validated Learned-from); the Improve's own commit then holds only its diff.

11. Result fields: learned [str], decisions [str] (each required at done, ['none'] allowed) and optional learned_from [{commit, contribution}]; gate refuses a missing/placeholder field or an unreachable commit. Step-plan, test-spec, implement and the step's Improve handoff quote the last 2 non-bookkeeping commits by value (anchored at the step's entry HEAD), plus the step's own previous commit on a revisit.

12. Consistency: matches fix-plan F14/D6 and T14 except 'since this item began' (it would hide 8947618, the item base head and S1's key JSON.serialize lesson); reverses the 2026-10-10 plan's T8 (learned_from left stage results because citations never reached a commit; a step commit is that commit); supersedes run-insights E6's printed git log -7; satisfies the owner's 2026-10-10 items 1, 3, 4.

part4_design.intent: Each accepted inline implement step leaves one commit whose message is the step's durable memory (learnings, decisions, evidence, the commits that helped); the next step-plan, test-spec, implement and the step's Improve read the last two such messages by value, so a later or repeated step reuses them instead of rediscovering them.
consumers: the next two step packets and their Improve handoffs (by value, at render)
the step's own Improve review (Review base: git show <step commit>)
step-plan and test-spec on a revise (by value)
verify's item commit (commits what is left: tests, docs)

when_and_what_is_committed.when: In shiploop_navigator's complete path, after save and beside _item_commit/_preparatory_commit: a new _step_commit(root, before, after, action_id) runs when the accepted transition is an inline implement step's done (gates passed: step Proof, lint, scope). The Improve child is already bound by then, but its bind snapshot and the until-loop's _content_tree are working-content trees (improve_changes._snapshot, until_loop_ephemeral._workspace_tree), so a commit does not move them; improve_changes.review_changes then reports only the review's own edits as pending, and improve-commit commits only the review's diff (the 4c5b99b case becomes a review-sized diff).
when_and_what_is_committed.paths: The step's changed paths since its entry tree (the action record's 'base' from _step_entry, diffed against a fresh snapshot with improve_changes._diff), filtered by item_scope.commit_scope(declared, withheld); HOME (knowledge.in_home) excluded so the knowledge commit after the stage keeps owning docs/shiploop/ and its ID check. Undeclared paths stay for verify's notice. No per-step path fence (fix plan D3).
when_and_what_is_committed.no_change: No file to commit: no commit when learned and decisions are both ['none'] (the round-2 'carried over unchanged' steps); otherwise an empty commit carrying the message (the release-verify always-commit precedent and the owner's empty-delta rule, memory item 3).
when_and_what_is_committed.ask_agent_route: One implement action builds every step: one commit for the action, subject 'feat(<item>/<first>-<last>): <headline>'.
when_and_what_is_committed.verify: _item_commit unchanged: commit_paths stages only paths that still differ from HEAD, so it commits what the steps left (tests, README, docs). Test base runs and changed-path scopes read snapshot trees (lint.read_base, item_scope.changed_since), not HEAD, so step commits move neither.
when_and_what_is_committed.printed: 'ShipLoop committed step S1 of W1 as <12 hex>: <paths>.' after the packet, like the item commit notice.
